data.name: Trinidad and Tobago
data.blurb: Trinidad and Tobago is a two-island republic in the Caribbean, off the northeast Venezuelan coast.

data.name: Tunisia
data.blurb: Tunisia is the northernmost African republic, on the Mediterranean between Algeria and Libya.

data.name: Turkey
data.blurb: Turkey is a republic across Southeast Europe and Western Asia, between the Black and Aegean seas.

data.name: Turkmenistan
data.blurb: Turkmenistan is a Central Asian republic on the Caspian Sea, mostly covered by the Karakum desert.

data.name: Turks and Caicos Islands
data.blurb: The Turks and Caicos Islands are a British overseas territory of two groups below the Bahamas.

data.name: Tuvalu
data.blurb: Tuvalu is a Polynesian state made up of nine low-lying atolls and reef islands in the Pacific.

data.name: Uganda
data.blurb: Uganda is a landlocked East African republic on the northern shore of Lake Victoria and the Nile.

data.name: Ukraine
data.blurb: Ukraine is a republic in Eastern Europe on the Black Sea and the second-largest state in Europe.

data.name: United Arab Emirates
data.blurb: The United Arab Emirates is a federation of seven emirates on the Arabian Peninsula, bordering Oman.

data.name: United Kingdom
data.official: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
data.blurb: The United Kingdom is an island state made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

data.name: United States
data.blurb: The United States is a federal republic of fifty states spanning the middle of North America.

data.name: United States Minor Outlying Islands
data.blurb: The United States Minor Outlying Islands are nine scattered island and reef territories.

data.name: United States Virgin Islands
data.official: Virgin Islands of the United States
data.blurb: The United States Virgin Islands are an unincorporated territory in the eastern Caribbean.

data.name: Uruguay
data.blurb: Uruguay is a republic on the Atlantic coast of South America, between Brazil and Argentina.

data.name: Uzbekistan
data.blurb: Uzbekistan is a landlocked Central Asian republic bordered only by other landlocked countries.

data.name: Vanuatu
data.blurb: Vanuatu is a South Pacific republic of some eighty islands of volcanic origin, east of Australia.

data.name: Vatican City
data.blurb: Vatican City is a walled enclave within Rome and the smallest sovereign state in the world.

data.name: Venezuela
data.blurb: Venezuela is a federal republic on the northern coast of South America, facing the Caribbean.

data.name: Vietnam
data.blurb: Vietnam is a Southeast Asian state running along the eastern edge of the Indochinese Peninsula.

data.name: Wallis and Futuna
data.official: Territory of the Wallis and Futuna Islands
data.blurb: Wallis and Futuna is a French overseas collectivity of three main islands in the South Pacific.

data.name: Western Sahara
data.blurb: Western Sahara is a disputed territory on the northwest African coast, mostly held by Morocco.

data.name: Yemen
data.blurb: Yemen is a republic at the southern end of the Arabian Peninsula, on the Red and Arabian seas.

data.name: Zambia
data.blurb: Zambia is a landlocked republic in Southern Africa, on the upper Zambezi river and its plateau.

data.name: Zimbabwe
data.blurb: Zimbabwe is a landlocked republic in Southern Africa, between the Zambezi and Limpopo rivers.

data.name: Åland Islands
data.blurb: Åland is an autonomous, Swedish-speaking archipelago of Finland in the Baltic Sea near Sweden.
